full_page.content:
1945, July 30
Page Two
V. Brother Leo, O.F.M. Cap.
Page 2
Any photos or pictures of Fr. Solanus or the others I hardly know what I should do with them: so you may burn them if you wish. However, I would like to have the one of our golden jubilee that is framed viz. the one with all the little grandchildren. Some of them are grandparents now themselves.
Well I guess I'd better come to a conclusion. Otherwise -- ?? Best regards to Br. Rufin and to all. Hope Br. Gerard is improving and that he'll get out of any further operation.
Best wishes to all our friends - inside and out who may be interested.
Sincerely in the Sacred Heart
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
P.S. The overcoat and habit arrived okay. Many thanks.
